paragraphs.text: Plots must be cultivated: if more than half a plot is weeds in July, the committee sends a warning letter and may end the tenancy after a second warning. Sheds need permission and may not exceed 6 square metres.

Hoses may be used only between 6 pm and 8 am. Bonfires are permitted from November to February, on Saturdays only. Dogs must be kept on the paths; children are welcome but remain the responsibility of the plot holder.

items.prompt: A plot can be taken away after one warning.
Permission is required before building a shed.
Hoses may be used at midday in summer.
Children are not allowed on the allotments.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
